snippet.title: Dead Stop: No Vacancy - Teaser
snippet.description:
Dead Stop is an anthology of short horror games. En episodic experience inspired by classic horror stories.
No Vacancy is the first episode.

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094896
